items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Turn More Cautious
items.snippet: Modeled fair value trimmed from US$172.56 to US$168.56. Bullish teams highlight resilient lithium demand and cost discipline, while cautious views focus on pricing pressure and higher discount rates.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Lithium is up about 67% year over year but well below all-time highs; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered its Albemarle price target to $175 from $200 and keeps Outperform, cutting lithium targets after recent spot price weakness, but still views the group as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized a tight lithium market from strong EV and stationary storage demand with supply lagging; 2026 outlook maintained at the high end of scenario ranges; $100 million run-rate savings achieved year to date.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in six months as lithium prices pulled back on softer China EV demand, elevated inventories and mine restarts; energy-storage demand remains resilient.

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of talks ahead of a strike; the deal must be ratified by member vote.
